translations.web: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
translations.bsb: So God made the expanse and separated the waters beneath it from the waters above. And it was so.
translations.kjv: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
